title: Is there any plugin to controller input?

posts.author: DiogoAsgard
posts.body: Is there any plugin for RPG Maker MV that allows me to remap the controller buttons? Because to access the menu in my game, you have to press the letter "I" instead of "Esc." And this is not possible using a controller. Is there any plugin that can help me with this?

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
I thought controller input was supported by default for MV? In any case,
a quick google search
revealed one by
Yanfly
and another by
Sigureya
.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
You can remap it with a script call.
For example
Input.gamepadMapper[0] = 'ok'; //A
1 = B
2 = X
3 = Y
4 = LB
5 = RB
6 = LT
7= RT
8 = start
9 = select
